g.text: err = LinkDisabled, disconnect, parity error or ESC error. FCT, N-Char and BC are characters received
after gotNull. Port reset: ErrorReset from any state. The transmitter is enabled in Started, Connecting
and Run, the receiver in every state except ErrorReset.
